title: Reuse retained same-plane edge digest for evidence materialization
objective: Delete the second exact canonical hash of a retained same-plane ForestEdge from the evidence observer path by carrying the already-authoritative Fourfold-admission digest through the existing ephemeral edge record, without introducing a persistent digest index, cache, caller trust, second fact store, compiler, receipt family, or authority.

implementation.before: Same-plane admission computed canonical_sha(edge.to_dict()) as edge_digest to prove exact membership in the authoritative Fourfold plane; later _forest_edge_atoms recomputed canonical_sha(edge.to_dict()) again when the evidence observer materialized the same retained edge.
implementation.after: The existing ephemeral edge_records owner carries the already-admitted edge_digest beside the edge and canonical indices. _forest_edge_atoms now returns only the raw ForestEdge.evidence tuple, and the evidence materialization path prefixes the retained edge_digest before the existing _record_fact sort/dedup boundary.
implementation.semantic_boundary: Fourfold retained-relation membership remains the only admission authority. Forest/Fourfold identity checks, endpoint partitioning, cross-plane verified binding admission, undirected/hyperedge refusal, observer semantics, evidence canonicalization, promotion policy, and receipt contracts are unchanged.
implementation.gardener_result: reuse the already-computed authority-bound ephemeral digest instead of adding a cache or second digest index

focused_contract.behavior: For the exact retained ForestEdge payloads in the existing evidence fixture, module-local canonical_sha calls equal the number of retained edges while the compiled EvidenceValue alternatives remain byte/canonical-equivalent to canonical_sha(edge.to_dict()) plus the edge witnesses.
focused_contract.normalization_contract: test_forest_edge_evidence_normalizes_once_at_fact_boundary continues to pin _record_fact as the sole sort/dedup owner; _forest_edge_atoms returns raw evidence only.

evidence.note: No hosted workflow had registered for the initial focused head before main reintegration. The branch was reintegrated with current main by a non-force merge commit preserving both histories and the two GPU-118 blobs; this packet commit is intended to trigger exact-head verification.
